coordinate_system: X lateral, Y forward, Z up; fire contact lies on floor z=0

label_contract.p_fire: clean contact point normalised by original image width/height
label_contract.p_fire_noisy: simulated detector/ROI observation; never ground truth
label_contract.fire_xyz_world: metric 3D contact point in room frame

split_policy: sequence/scene-level split: adjacent frames stay together

noise_policy.image_noise: Gaussian sensor noise, blur, brightness and JPEG compression
noise_policy.label_noise: pixel Gaussian perturbation plus miss probability
